summary: Answered all 7 of the owner's notes from 31 Oct. Started an A/B where money travels between things and things fly in instead of popping and shaking, built a livelier cinematic music bed ready to test, queued the owner's hook pattern as the next hook test, and reverted the loop-picture test.
why: Owner notes come first: three say the animation is basic, popping and static (5/10), two that hooks lack curiosity, one that the cinematic music is dull. The evaluator said revert for loop-picture-matches-hook (QA/fact failures 18% vs 0%), which freed one experiment slot.

findings.title: loop-picture-matches-hook: revert
findings.detail: QA/fact failures 18% with the change (2 of 11 attempts) vs 0% without (0 of 7); 39.4% vs 35.0% viewed, n 3 vs 2.

findings.title: Other experiments still collecting
findings.detail: hook-voice-matches-frame 7 of 8 per arm (about a day), title-names-the-moment 5 of 8, quiet-bed and chart-gap-fill 1 of 4 long videos per arm.

findings.title: Shorts with 48 h data: 36
findings.detail: Cinematic music 13.4x median views (69.6% viewed, n=6); hook style secret 11.0x (74.8%), question 1.05x (37.9%), myth 0.14x (27.0%); length 25-29 s 7.5x, 50-54 s 0.14x.

findings.title: No format retired
findings.detail: rule_change is the only weak story with 3+ Shorts (42.9% viewed): not under the median for two weeks.

changes.title: Money travels, things arrive (A/B on half the Shorts)
changes.detail: remotion/src/studio/build.tsx + travel.ts: things fly in from the nearer side or grow out of the thing before them and land with a squash; shake is a hop; new 'flow' verb sends notes on an arc between two things with the figure riding on them. Writers in the on-group are told to use it whenever money changes hands. Checked on the McDonald's Short's timeline, layout gate clean.

changes.title: Livelier cinematic bed, ready to test
changes.detail: renderer/engine/music.py: major-first chords, soft kick and shaker from bar 1, snare from bar 3. Behind its flag, starts when an experiment slot frees.

changes.title: Reverted loop-picture-matches-hook
changes.detail: Prompt dropped from config/experiments.json; status reverted.

changes.title: Answered the owner's 7 notes
changes.detail: improvement/feedback-acks.json: 3 fixed (animation), 4 noted (music and hook tests queued, the McDonald's pick read as taste).
